# KRATOR Attachments

Excavator Attachments for Demolition, Piling and Earthmoving

This website supplies excavator attachments for overseas contractors, dealers and rental companies.

- English: https://www.kratorattachments.com/
- Spanish: https://www.kratorattachments.com/es/
- French: https://www.kratorattachments.com/fr/
- Russian: https://www.kratorattachments.com/ru/
- Arabic: https://www.kratorattachments.com/ar/

## Technical resources
- Hydraulic Breaker Troubleshooting Guide: https://www.kratorattachments.com/blog/hydraulic-breaker-troubleshooting-guide/ (Safe symptom recording, external checks, technician escalation and support data)

## Buyer information needed
Please provide excavator model, carrier weight, pin diameter, arm width, center distance, working condition, quantity and destination country for a quote.
